 The post  Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Act
news.aiSummary: Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a Mixture of Experts model featuring 2.8 trillion total parameters with 104 billion active parameters and a 1 million token context window.
